Find an article on Wikipedia

4 steps · starts at en.wikipedia.org

  1. 1

    Go to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page

  2. 2

    Type "Chrome extension" into the "Search Wikipedia" field

  3. 3

    Press Enter

  4. 4

    Click the "Talk" link
